actions.value:
Dear Meta,

We are Guangzhou Weilaiya Biotechnology Co., Ltd – the trademark owner responsible for protecting the WEILAIYA brand across all online platforms.

We respectfully request that Meta remove the content, images, accounts, and pages that are infringing upon the trademark rights of WEILAIYA . The attached links refer to counterfeit products that are not part of our official supply chain and pose serious risks to our brand reputation and consumer safety.

We urge Meta to take swift and effective action on this matter.

Sincerely
